term: dated duty, practical ability, actual fulfillment and retrospective responsibility
definition: Case is one fixed agent with four independent Stage → Action → Prop fields: duty, able, fulfilled, responsible. Stage has before, after and later; Action distinguishes originalReturn (the identical borrowed object), compensation and debtRepayment. Destruction of the original does not define a compensation duty. Fields are analyst stipulations, with no moral rule inferred from descriptive facts. A laterFrame edge is strict chronological succession in the finite example. FutureCan is existential later practical ability, not actual later performance or unrestricted possibility.
note: Logic-first working reconstruction for #1035 using the existing deontology note. Attribution deferred; no source or author-intention claim. One fixed agent is encoded by retaining one Case throughout, not changing bearer across dates.
